solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique, linked answer split by the grid); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: How 25 would negotiate fee-free arrangement with fat human chain-smoker

definitions.note: 25 across is GODFATHER: the film's famous line is how Don Corleone negotiates

indicators.note: an arrangement sets things in a new order, so the letters of the following words are reordered

explanation.surface: A deal is struck with an overweight heavy smoker, with no fees charged.
explanation.walkthrough: 'arrangement' signals that all the letters of FEE-FREE, FAT, HUMAN and CHAIN-SMOKER are rearranged into the famous line from The Godfather, spread over four lights.
explanation.definitionFit: In The Godfather, Vito Corleone's menacing negotiating style is summed up by this quoted line about an unrefusable proposal.

clue.text: Mafia's greatest includes black queens

indicators.note: one word including another holds it inside itself

parts.note: the greatest is the most
B is the standard abbreviation for black (as on pencils)
ER (Elizabeth Regina) is a queen, so queens are ERS

explanation.surface: The top figures of the Mafia count some black queens among them, like a card hand.
explanation.definitionFit: The Mafia as a body is made up of gangsters, so the plural answer stands for the organisation's members.

clue.text: Capital place to bury cars, reportedly

indicators.note: reportedly means as heard, so the phrase is said aloud

parts.note: a place to bury cars would be a car tomb

explanation.surface: A city reputed to be a graveyard for scrapped vehicles.
explanation.walkthrough: Said aloud, 'car tomb' sounds like the Sudanese capital.
explanation.definitionFit: This city is the seat of government of Sudan, its national capital.

clue.text: See 1 across
Distance is mainly easy, oddly

indicators.note: oddly means take the letters in odd-numbered positions of these words

explanation.surface: A route that is, for the most part, an easy walk.
explanation.definitionFit: Distance is commonly measured in this imperial unit, so the plural names a distance covered.

clue.text: See 1 across
Was older so wanted a Te Deum inside

indicators.note: inside says the answer sits within the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: Someone senior wished to have a hymn of praise sung within.
explanation.walkthrough: The Te Deum is a Latin hymn of praise.
explanation.definitionFit: To antedate something is to come before it in time, that is, to be older than it.

clue.text: Mishap involving new leader in the west

indicators.note: a new leader means the word's first letter is swapped for a different one

parts.note: a mishap is an accident

explanation.surface: An accident in which a fresh boss takes charge out west.
explanation.walkthrough: The new first letter is not clued; the definition and crossings fix it.
explanation.definitionFit: The Occident is a literary term for the Western world, the opposite of the Orient.

clue.text: Could make well over top mark

definitions.text: Could make well over top mark

parts.words: Could make well over top mark
parts.note: filling a well or tank to and past its top mark is to top it up completely

explanation.walkthrough: The blogger was unsure: one reading is filling a vessel up to its top mark, another a double definition with eyes that 'well over' with tears.
explanation.definitionFit: To top up a container to its brim is to replenish it completely, past the full line.

clue.text: See 1 across
Wager about farm land starting slight division

indicators.note: about means going round, so the wager surrounds the rest

parts.note: a wager is a bet
a ranch is a farm, especially for cattle

indicators.note: starting means take only the first letter of land

explanation.surface: A bet on a ranch and its land, beginning a small partition of property.
explanation.definitionFit: A small offshoot of a tree is a twig, a minor division of a bough.

clue.text: Religious leader's state

definitions.meaning: a variant spelling of caliph, a Muslim leader

explanation.surface: The condition of a cleric at the head of a faith.
explanation.definitionFit: A caliph led the Islamic community, and this short form is the postal-style abbreviation for a US state.

clue.text: Induced seizure: offensive plant to dead head

parts.note: the Tet Offensive was a 1968 Vietnam War campaign
anise is the plant that gives aniseed

indicators.note: head means take the first letter of dead

explanation.surface: Someone suffered a fit after a nasty plant was put on a dead person's head.
explanation.walkthrough: 'offensive' looks like an adjective for 'plant', but it is the Tet Offensive of the Vietnam War.
explanation.definitionFit: To tetanise is to bring on tetanic spasm, a sustained muscular convulsion.

clue.text: Subject of traffic control measures?

parts.note: traffic here is illegal trade, not road vehicles, and the control measures are anti-smuggling rules

explanation.walkthrough: 'traffic control' suggests road cones and signals; the trade being policed is illicit dealing.
explanation.definitionFit: Narcotics are the classic contraband of illegal trafficking that police and customs try to stop.

clue.text: Playboy's extremely roguish issue

indicators.note: extremely here means keep only the extreme pairs of letters at each end of the phrase, dropping the middle

explanation.surface: A womaniser's thoroughly rascally offspring.
explanation.walkthrough: 'extremely' keeps the first two and last two letters of 'roguish issue', RO and UE.
explanation.definitionFit: A roué is a debauched man of pleasure, a rake or libertine.

clue.text: Maybe rose with fire engine siren sound

definitions.meaning: some roses are two colours, petals shading from one to another
the old British fire-engine siren alternated two notes

explanation.surface: A siren that may have risen with a fire engine.
explanation.definitionFit: Two-tone describes anything with two colours, as some roses, or two alternating notes, as an old siren.

clue.text: Clue to redo criminal

parts.note: read as wordplay, the answer split as wrong (an anagram signal) and doer is a clue that leads to the word redo

explanation.surface: A puzzle setter's instruction to rewrite a clue about a crook.
explanation.walkthrough: A reverse clue: WRONG DOER would be wordplay for REDO, with WRONG meaning rearrange DOER.
explanation.definitionFit: A wrongdoer is someone who breaks the law, a criminal or offender.

clue.text: Obliged to keep insect outside before noon

indicators.note: the insect is placed outside, so it wraps round the other word

parts.note: a bee is an insect
to keep is to hold

explanation.surface: Someone required to keep a bug wrapped up until midday.
explanation.definitionFit: To be beholden to someone is to owe them a debt of gratitude, to be indebted.

clue.text: Sound of Caledonian monster

definitions.meaning: a loch is a Scottish lake or sea inlet, and a sound is a strait or inlet
Caledonia is Scotland; its famous monster is Nessie, named for its loch

explanation.walkthrough: 'Sound' suggests noise; here it is a body of water. The whole clue also describes the loch where Nessie lives.
explanation.definitionFit: This Highland loch is both a stretch of water and the name for its legendary Scottish creature.

clue.text: Signora runs around post

indicators.note: around here means the letters are turned about into a fresh order

parts.note: R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

explanation.surface: An Italian lady jogs round a pole.
explanation.definitionFit: A garrison is a military post, the troops stationed in a fort or town.

clue.text: Gets another round in ready for more shots

definitions.meaning: a gun ... with another round of ammunition, punning on buying drinks
a gun that ... is made ready to fire again

explanation.surface: Someone at the bar buys the next round, ready for more shots of spirits.
explanation.definitionFit: Putting fresh ammunition in a firearm prepares it to fire again, and a round is one cartridge.

clue.text: Schedule partial return of moratorium

indicators.note: return means the letters are read backwards
partial means only part of the word moratorium is used

explanation.surface: A timetable for partly lifting a suspension.
explanation.walkthrough: 'partial' picks ATOR from moratorium and 'return of' turns it round.
explanation.definitionFit: A rota is a roster, a list showing who does a duty and when.

clue.text: Sack for not starting jabbing when ordered

indicators.note: ordered means the remaining letters are put into a new order
not starting means the first letter of jabbing is dropped

explanation.surface: Dismissal for refusing to start vaccinations once instructed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not starting' leaves ABBING, which 'when ordered' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: A bin bag is a plastic sack for household rubbish.

clue.text: Corruption at No 10 leads to Sunak looking excited and zero endorsement

indicators.note: leads means the first letters of each of the following words

explanation.surface: Downing Street scandal: the Prime Minister looks excited and gives no backing.
explanation.walkthrough: No 10 Downing Street is the British prime minister's residence; Rishi Sunak was then Chancellor.
explanation.definitionFit: Political sleaze is underhand dealing or corruption, a word much used of government scandals.

clue.text: Better place for chips?

parts.note: a better here is one who bets, and chips are gambling counters, not fried potato

explanation.walkthrough: 'Better' looks like a comparative; it is a gambler.
explanation.definitionFit: A gambling house is where punters stake counters on games of chance.

clue.text: Blocks arrangement to build white house

definitions.text: Blocks arrangement to build white house

parts.words: Blocks arrangement to build white house
parts.note: snow blocks are arranged into a dome, a house that is white with snow

explanation.walkthrough: 'Blocks arrangement' hints at an anagram and 'white house' at Washington; both mislead.
explanation.definitionFit: An Inuit snow hut is built from cut snow blocks laid in a spiral dome.

clue.text: After start of game ref had to change sponsor

indicators.note: After places the rearranged letters following the first piece
start of means take the first letter of game
change here means the letters of the referee's phrase are put into another order

explanation.surface: Once the match began, the referee had to switch backer.
explanation.definitionFit: A godparent sponsors a child at baptism, vouching for its religious upbringing.

clue.text: Noise level overwhelms small nerd

indicators.note: overwhelms means surrounds and engulfs the other word

parts.note: dB, decibel, is the unit of noise level
wee is Scottish for small

explanation.surface: A loud din drowns out a little geek.
explanation.definitionFit: A dweeb is a socially awkward, studious person, American slang for a geek.

clue.text: Apple is one of a kind

definitions.meaning: Apple is a company and trade name
a kind or sort, as in a ... of humour

explanation.surface: Apple is unique, a one-off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Apple' looks like fruit; it is the tech company.
explanation.definitionFit: A trademark name like Apple is a brand, and a brand also means a sort or variety.

clue.text: Jokes about electric ships

parts.note: on means about, as in a talk on a topic
E is short for electric
liners are large passenger ships

explanation.surface: Gags concerning battery-powered vessels.
explanation.definitionFit: One-liners are short quips or wisecracks, each delivered in a single sentence.

clue.text: Less experienced in meagre energy use

indicators.note: in says the answer lies within the words that follow

explanation.surface: A novice uses only a little power.
explanation.walkthrough: 'greener' doubles as more eco-friendly, fitting the energy surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Green means raw and inexperienced, so the comparative means more of a novice.

clue.text: Contemptible person nearly wearing good French garment

indicators.note: wearing means one word is put on, surrounding the other

parts.note: bon is French for good

indicators.note: nearly means drop the last letter

parts.note: a louse is a contemptible person

explanation.surface: A rotter almost dressed in fine French clothing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wearing' puts LOUS (LOUSE less its last letter, from 'nearly') inside BON.
explanation.definitionFit: A blouson is a short jacket gathered at the waist, an item of clothing.
